exposure: abnormal intrapartum fetal heart rate tracing
cohort: Live, non-anomalous newborns ≥35 weeks gestation, not delivered by pre-labor cesarean section, from the Nova Scotia Atlee Perinatal Database (1988-2015) and the AC Allen Perinatal Follow-Up Program Database (2006-2015)
finding: Several intrapartum factors were associated with an increased risk of HIE in infants born at ≥35 weeks gestation.
mod_finding: Emergency cesarean delivery was associated with a higher risk of HIE compared to other modes of delivery.
